scenarios.title: Send RFQ to single supplier with valid lines

steps.statement: I enter "Shipping to another base" in "Note to suppliers"
I enter "New York JFK" in "named place"
I enter "Internal note for the team" in "Internal note"
I see "RFQ saved successfully" is visible

scenarios.title: Send RFQ to multiple suppliers with valid lines

steps.statement: I enter "Shipping to another base" in "Note to suppliers"
I enter "New York JFK" in "named place"
I enter "supplier1@company.com; supplier2@company.com" in "sales@supplier.com; several with ;"
I enter "Internal note for the team" in "Internal note"
I see "RFQ saved successfully" is visible
I enter "Shipping to another base" in "Note to suppliers"
I enter "New York JFK" in "named place"
I enter "Internal note for the team" in "Internal note"
I see "RFQ sent successfully" is visible
